features.name: Deals Pipeline & Kanban Board
features.description: Visual drag-and-drop sales pipeline board featuring customizable deal stages, deal monetary values, win probabilities, and rotten deal highlighting.

features.name: Contacts & Companies Management
features.description: Unified management of individual contacts and corporate accounts with customizable fields, association mapping, and activity timelines.

features.name: Activity & Task Tracking
features.description: Task management system for logging phone calls, meetings, follow-ups, and notes with automated reminders and team calendar views.

features.name: Sales Reporting & Analytics
features.description: Analytics dashboard providing pipeline conversion funnel reports, deal loss reason analysis, revenue forecasting, and sales rep performance metrics.

features.name: WordPress Lead Capture Forms
features.description: Shortcode and Gutenberg block integration to embed lead generation forms into WordPress pages, automatically creating contacts and deals upon submission.

features.name: SMS Gateway & Email Notifications
features.description: Integration with Iranian SMS providers (Kavenegar, IPPanel, FarazSMS) and email notifications for automated follow-ups and stage updates.

features.name: Deal Automation & Workflow Triggers
features.description: Rule-based automated triggers that assign tasks, send SMS/email alerts, or adjust deal properties when a deal transitions between stages.

features.name: Role-Based Access Control & Team Management
features.description: Granular user permissions defining access levels for sales reps, team leads, and administrators with deal ownership privacy controls.
